meta.title: Interface experience
meta.description: Make the DSH interface follow the Material You palette matugen generates on the system. After enabling Settings → General → Matugen palette sync, the palette is layered over the current theme and follows the file whenever matugen regenerates it. Expand Palette file paths on the same row to rewrite the matugen colors file or the DSH token file path (both default under ~/.local/state/quickshell/user/generated/, the token file wins when present). Palette files are read locally and never uploaded; turning the switch off returns the native colors. Also unifies the interface border width (config option borderWidth, default 0.5px); that override applies only while the switch is on and narrows decorative borders such as markdown quote rules.
